newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall $379 mln in April 1-10.
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall $379 mln in April 1-10.

text.p: Poland's net foreign currency reserves fell by $379 million in April 1-10 to $20.715 billion and were $1.09 billion lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said net reserves fell $951 million in the January-April 10 period compared to a $1.37 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) APRIL 10 MARCH FEB APRIL '96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
